notes: Project agents: 'make a Gun Bros agent' gives a project its own Jarvis that reads the whole project into a second brain, keeps its own notes, and works in the background ('Gun Bros Jarvis, add a reload system') while you keep using Jarvis; every agent and Jarvis himself see what the others are doing. Instant project lookups: 'where's the damage code in Gun Bros?'. Dream mode: at 04:00 Jarvis thinks over your week and has three ideas waiting in the morning, each with a Do it button.
